data.name: ChangeSchema
data.value: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS company_knowledge_changes ( sequence BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, category TEXT NOT NULL, entity_id TEXT NOT NULL, version_id TEXT NOT NULL, known_at TEXT NOT NULL, known_ticks BIGINT NOT NULL, company_ids TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(category,entity_id,version_id));

data.name: ReadNextChange
data.value: SELECT sequence AS "Sequence",category AS "Category",entity_id AS "EntityId",version_id AS "VersionId",known_at AS "KnownAt",company_ids AS "CompanyIds" FROM company_knowledge_changes WHERE sequence>@after ORDER BY sequence LIMIT 1

data.name: KnowledgeSchema
FindKnowledgeHash
data.value: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT hash FROM company_knowledge_revisions WHERE category=@c AND entity_id=@e AND revision_id=@r), '')

data.name: LatestKnowledge
data.value: SELECT k.payload FROM company_knowledge_revisions k WHERE category=@c AND known_ticks <= @t AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM company_knowledge_revisions newer WHERE newer.category=k.category AND newer.entity_id=k.entity_id AND newer.known_ticks <= @t AND newer.known_ticks>k.known_ticks) ORDER BY entity_id

data.name: AllKnowledge
data.value: SELECT payload FROM company_knowledge_revisions WHERE category=@c AND known_ticks <= @t ORDER BY entity_id,known_ticks
